name: revise-paper
description: Autonomous paper revision from peer review reports. TRIGGER when: user has referee reports and wants to revise a paper, or says "revise my paper", "handle the reviews", "process referee reports", "address the referee comments". Works with both LaTeX (.tex) and Word (.docx) papers. Parses reports into a deduplicated JSON checklist, clusters issues, dispatches parallel editing agents, applies edits with git commits, compiles/validates after each batch with auto-fix, runs verification, and produces a response-to-reviewers letter. Halts on irreducible ambiguity.
